title: Matches https://code.launchpad.net/~lvoytek/ubuntu/+source/ubuntu-release-upgrader/+git/ubuntu-release-upgrader/+merge/510234 for resolute
diff:
diff --git a/DistUpgrade/DistUpgradeQuirks.py b/DistUpgrade/DistUpgradeQuirks.py
index 02eea03..909a1a0 100644
--- a/DistUpgrade/DistUpgradeQuirks.py
+++ b/DistUpgrade/DistUpgradeQuirks.py
@@ -96,6 +96,7 @@ class DistUpgradeQuirks(object):
         self._test_and_fail_on_z13()
         self._test_and_fail_on_pi_old_eeprom()
         self._test_and_fail_rabbitmq_server_installed_and_not_upgradable()
+        self._test_and_fail_mysql_server_using_mysql_native_password()
 
         self._test_and_fail_on_tpm_fde()
 
@@ -1593,3 +1594,146 @@ class DistUpgradeQuirks(object):
             )
             self._view.error(summary, message)
             self.controller.abort()
+
+    def _check_mysql_native_password_explicitly_enabled(self):
+        """
+        Check whether mysql_native_password is explicitly enabled in the
+        MySQL server configuration.
+        This is a valid workaround in MySQL 8.4 on resolute.
+
+        The plugin is considered enabled if configured with an optional
+        'loose' prefix, dashes or underscores, and with no value, =on, =force
+        or =force_plus_permanent.
+        """
+        pattern = re.compile(
+            r'^\s*(loose[-_])?mysql[-_]native[-_]password\s*'
+            r'(=\s*(on|force|force_plus_permanent)(\s|$)|$)',
+            re.IGNORECASE)
+        conf_dirs = ('/etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d', '/etc/mysql/conf.d')
+        for conf_dir in conf_dirs:
+            for conf_file in glob.glob(os.path.join(conf_dir, '*.cnf')):
+                try:
+                    with open(conf_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8',
+                              errors='replace') as f:
+                        for line in f:
+                            if pattern.match(line.rstrip('\n')):
+                                return True
+                except OSError:
+                    continue
+        return False
+
+    def _get_mysql_native_password_users(self):
+        """
+        Get the list of up to 3 MySQL accounts still using the
+        mysql_native_password authentication plugin. Returns an empty list if
+        the pre-upgrade server is not running or the query fails. Adds ... if
+        there are more than 3 users.
+        """
+        # Confirm the pre-upgrade server is currently running
+        try:
+            subprocess.run(
+                ['mysqladmin', 'ping'],
+                check=True,
+                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+            return []
+
+        # List users with mysql_native_password plugin connected
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ['mysql', '--defaults-file=/etc/mysql/debian.cnf',
+                 '--batch', '--skip-column-names', '-e',
+                 "SELECT CONCAT(User, '@', Host) FROM mysql.user "
+                 "WHERE plugin = 'mysql_native_password';"],
+                check=True,
+                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                universal_newlines=True)
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+            return []
+
+        users = [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+        # Show root accounts first, and cap the list at 3 entries
+        users.sort(key=lambda user: not user.startswith('root'))
+
+        if len(users) > 3:
+            return users[:3] + ['...']
+
+        return users
+
+    def _test_and_fail_mysql_server_using_mysql_native_password(self):
+        """
+        MySQL Server installations with accounts using the
+        'mysql_native_password' authentication plugin will have those accounts
+        locked out completely in MySQL 9.7 and will have them locked out
+        without enabling it explicitly in MySQL 8.4.
+        """
+        cache = self.controller.cache
+        if 'mysql-server' not in cache \
+                or not cache['mysql-server'].is_installed:
+            return
+
+        summary = _('Unable to upgrade MySQL')
+
+        # 8.0 -> 8.4
+        if self.controller.toDist == "resolute":
+            # Plugin enabled in config, fine as is.
+            if self._check_mysql_native_password_explicitly_enabled():
+                return
+
+            native_password_users = self._get_mysql_native_password_users()
+            if not native_password_users:
+                return
+
+            users = '\n'.join(native_password_users)
+
+            message = _(
+                'The following MySQL accounts use the mysql_native_password '
+                'authentication plugin, which is disabled by default in the '
+                'version of MySQL shipped with this release:\n\n'
+                '{users}\n\n'
+                'These accounts would be locked out after the upgrade. '
+                'Please use a separate authentication method for them, '
+                'such as caching_sha2_password, or explicitly enable '
+                'mysql_native_password in your MySQL server configuration, '
+                'then try the upgrade again.\n\n'
+                'For more information, see https://documentation.ubuntu.com/'
+                'release-notes/26.04/summary-for-lts-users/#mysql'
+            ).format(users=users)
+
+        # 8.4 -> 9.7
+        else:
+            # Plugin not enabled in config in which case mysql_native_password
+            # users would already be locked out, fine as is.
+            if not self._check_mysql_native_password_explicitly_enabled():
+                return
+
+            native_password_users = self._get_mysql_native_password_users()
+            if not native_password_users:
+                message = _(
+                    'Your MySQL server configuration currently has the '
+                    'mysql_native_password plugin enabled, which is no longer '
+                    'a supported configuration option in the version of MySQL '
+                    'shipped with this release. Please remove the config '
+                    'entry, then try the upgrade again.')
+
+            else:
+                users = '\n'.join(native_password_users)
+
+                message = _(
+                    'The following MySQL accounts use the '
+                    'mysql_native_password authentication plugin, which is '
+                    'removed in the version of MySQL shipped with this '
+                    'release:\n\n'
+                    '{users}\n\n'
+                    'These accounts would be locked out after the upgrade. '
+                    'Please use a separate authentication method for them, '
+                    'such as caching_sha2_password, and disable the plugin in '
+                    'your MySQL server configuration, then try the upgrade '
+                    'again.'
+                ).format(users=users)
+
+        self._view.error(summary, message)
+        self.controller.abort()
